# deps: dependabot: configure updates for git submodules

Extend the Dependabot configuration ([[DOT-307]]) with the `gitsubmodule` ecosystem, per the [version-updates docs](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/dependabot/dependabot-version-updates/about-dependabot-version-updates), so that the `fonts`, `test/bats`, `test/helper/*` submodules are bumped by pull requests instead of by hand.
